solve.wl.raw: If[$FrontEnd===Null,$InputFileName,NotebookFileName[]]//DirectoryName//SetDirectory; Get["/n/holylabs/schwartz_lab/Lab/obarrera/amflow-verification/work/state/phase0-runs/linear_propagator/primary/amflow/diffeq_solver/DESolver.m"]; {masters, table} = Get["reduction"]; {mastersde, variables, diffeq} = Get["diffeq"]; {point, boundary} = Get["boundary"]; sol[n_]:=Module[{tablecoe,de,bc,masterexp,allexp}, SetDefaultOptions[]; SetGlobalOptions["WorkingPre" -> 246, "ChopPre" -> 20]; SetExpansionOptions["XOrder" -> 492, "LearnXOrder" -> -1, "TestXOrder" -> 5]; tablecoe = Values[table]/.{variables[[1]] -> eta, eps -> boundary[[n,1]]}//Factor; de = diffeq[[1]]/.{variables[[1]] -> eta, eps -> boundary[[n,1]]}//Factor; bc = boundary[[n,2]]; LoadSystem[n, de, bc, point[[2]]]; SolveAsyExp[n]; masterexp = masters/.Thread[mastersde -> AsyExp[n]]; allexp = PlusAsyExp@MapThread[TimesAsyExp, {#, masterexp}]&/@tablecoe; PickZeroRuleS/@allexp]; LaunchKernels[8]; results = ParallelTable[sol[i], {i, Length[boundary]}, DistributedContexts -> All]; CloseKernels[]; Put[Thread[Keys[table] -> Transpose[results]], "solution"]; Quit[];
